item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 17/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the next couple of days. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring showers to the region midweek this week. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will be hot over Guangdong in the latter part of this week to early next week.
